expandedBaseline.policy: Only original build inputs plus package version/export manifests; source snapshots are never patched

selected.ui: Original ShortcutsRow and ShortcutReference in the existing single React island; original shortcuts.open keyboard command
selected.authority: Original web shortcut preferences only, no model/session/backend configuration

selected.ui: Download message in existing captured-message context menu invokes original fileActions.save with a bounded Blob reader
selected.authority: A download request, not saved-path confirmation. No remote or filesystem port exposed
unsupported: Workspace file context-menu contributions needing Remote services

rejected.reason: Requires inputTriggers, sessions, remote and remote.commands; no current EAP command-directory contract
Durable settings/configForms and global stylesheet authority would duplicate EAP configuration/theme ownership
Requires DSH remote.settings schema and settings form lifecycle, not interchangeable with Java settings
Requires remote.account and accountUi, not a general browser toast contribution

nodeProviders: Explicitly unsupported; no Host package substitutions, second Host or arbitrary package loading
